subject: Post-demo recap and 30-day POC sprint outline
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Li <alex.li@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap and 30-day POC sprint outline

Hi Alex — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and a proposed 30-day POC sprint we discussed on the call so your team can review and confirm.

Demo highlights (brief):
- Inference latency for typical clinical note summarization: ~120ms p95 on a 64-token prompt (demo model).
- Embeddings for triage routing looked accurate on the small sample — will validate across a larger set.
- Security: shown VPC connector and audit log export (demo environment).

Proposed POC objectives (success criteria):
1) Accuracy: automated summaries hit ≥85% agreement with clinician review on a 200-record holdout.
2) Latency: p95 end-to-end API <=200ms at 5 TPS sustained for 30-day window.
3) Cost: projected per-1000-record token cost under $5 with suggested batching settings.
4) Security & compliance: KMS integration + audit log export validated by Lumina security.

30-day sprint (high level):
- Week 0 (kickoff): data access & security checklist, dataset handoff (small canonical set, ~200 records).
- Week 1: ingest + baseline runs, initial metric collection.
- Week 2: iterate prompt templates, sampling, and evaluation harness.
- Week 3: scale runs + latency load test; run cost estimates and batching knobs.
- Week 4: handover, decision call, and next-step recommendations.

Owners (proposed):
- Redwood: Ben Carter (sales owner) + Marissa Cole (technical lead) + Soojin Lee (implementation engineer).
- Lumina: Alex Li (clinical PM) + Samantha Cho (security).

Attachments: [Attachment: poc-outline-v1.pdf (PDF, 210KB)] — outlines metrics, what we need for the holdout, and a simple ownership matrix.

Questions for you:
- Does Lumina agree with the stated success criteria or should we prioritize differently?
- Can your security team confirm availability for the KMS + audit review during Week 0?

If that looks good, I’ll schedule a 45-minute kickoff for the week of July 5 and attach a short owner matrix with proposed owners and calendar invites.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Alex Li <alex.li@luminahealth.com>

Cc: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@luminahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap and 30-day POC sprint outline

Ben — thanks for the concise note and the clear goals. Quick answers from our side:

- Success criteria: the accuracy threshold looks reasonable; clinically we may want to validate precision on critical cases (e.g., diagnostic suggestions) separately — I’ll send a short list of priority condition types by tomorrow.
- Security: Samantha is available for a KMS + audit review; week of July 5 is OK but prefer July 6 or 7 for the kickoff so we can loop in our infra folks.
- Data: we can share a de-identified 200-record set for the holdout and a larger 2k-set for scaling tests — will confirm timelines.

Minor question: for the latency test, is the target (200ms p95) measured from our application to the response or just the Redwood service-to-response? Our infra team wants to make sure the numbers are comparable.

Appreciate the outline — looking forward to the kickoff.

—Alex
Alex Li | Product Manager, Lumina Health
alex.li@luminahealth.com | +1 646-555-0789

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Alex — thanks for the fast reply and for the data commitment. A couple quick clarifications and an owner matrix attached.

On latency: the SLA target we quoted is service-side (Redwood end-to-token-generation p95). For apples-to-apples with your app-side measurements we recommend one front-door run from your QA environment during Week 3 so we can record full RTT and compare. We'll include both numbers in the Week 3 report.

Ownership & timeline (attached owner-matrix.xlsx):
- Redwood: Marissa (tech lead, eval harness, prompt templates), Soojin (integration, infra, batching), Ben (program management + customer comms).
- Lumina: Alex (product/acceptance), Samantha (security sign-off), David Park (infra point-of-contact) — please confirm David and I’ll add him to the invite.

Deliverables summary:
- By July 9: De-identified 200-record holdout (Lumina).
- By July 16: Baseline metrics + prompt iteration summary (Redwood).
- By July 23: Load/latency runs + cost estimates (joint).
- By July 30: Final report + recommendation and decision meeting.

Attachments: [Attachment: owner-matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)]

I’ll draft a kickoff calendar invite for July 6 at 10am PT and share the meeting doc. If that conflicts, propose alternate time and Ben will coordinate. Also linking the HS record for tracking: https://redwood.app/hubspot/record/HS-98765.
